authority_note: Current shared working files, including concurrent uncommitted changes, are the technical reference. Hashes identify exact inspected bytes; HEAD alone is not a complete source snapshot. No runtime implementation was modified or benchmark rerun for this poster.
user_scope: The manuscript is background only; show the latest Tofu technology and reasons for researchers to try it. Include TofuDB; avoid a benchmark-centered story.

claims.claim: Three layers reduce working context while preserving recoverable evidence.
Compaction compares expected future savings with summary and warm-prefix disruption costs.
Captured requests and context decision receipts can be inspected; receipts are not proof of model consumption.
An isolated WASM JavaScript program can call task-admitted tools and process results. Each call retains authority checks. Incomplete results hand back to the model.
A storage-minted certificate reuses a verified prefix within an authority-open epoch. Earlier semantic mutations invalidate it; reopen reauthenticates.
After certification, adding two Turns visits three headers in the focused 8/128/2048 retained-Turn fixtures. This is logical verification work, not a latency ratio.
The native context reader removes private parse/serialize/copy cycles while preserving exact selected evidence and byte bounds.
Native, SQLite and PostgreSQL share semantic operations. SQLite already offers transactions and recovery; native engine superiority is not established by the poster.
Paper reader, harness inspection and editable orchestration are offered as an example research workflow, not a measured end-to-end experiment.
